review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. Location This role is fully remote in Canada About the job you are considering We're looking for a senior backend engineer to help design, migrate, and operate the power ingestion, processing, storage, and lifecycle management of user- and listing-generated media (images, video, and documents) across our platform. This role sits at the intersection of platform migration, data compliance, and service reliability — you'll own multi-quarter modernization efforts while ensuring the pipeline meets strict privacy and trust requirements. Your role Drive platform migrations end-to-end — design and execute the migration of legacy media-processing services onto a modern replacement platform, including data-model design, dual-write/backfill strategies, phased cutovers, and legacy cleanup. Build event-driven processing pipelines — design Kafka/event-schema-based consumers and producers to power asynchronous media-processing workflows (state machines, checkpoints, retries, idempotency guarantees). Own trust & privacy compliance in the data path — implement GDPR-compliant hard-deletion workflows across storage and CDN layers, integrate personal-data-detection and content-integrity checks into upload/creation flows, and build safe-content transformation pipelines for user-uploaded files. Integrate third-party media infrastructure — build and maintain integrations with external transcoding/processing vendors, including webhook handling, rate limiting, and failure handling. Ensure operational excellence — write on-call runbooks and alerting for critical endpoints, manage service-mesh permissions between internal services, tune consumer/throughput settings, and resolve reliability issues (memory, latency, backpressure). Evolve core data models and APIs — design and extend database schemas and GraphQL/API layers supporting media entities, with a focus on idempotency, consistency, and backward compatibility during migrations. Partner cross-functionally — work with trust & safety, privacy, and adjacent platform teams to translate compliance and product requirements into pipeline changes Must have skills 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, ideally on high-scale distributed systems. Strong experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka or equivalent), service meshes, and microservice-to-microservice integration. Experience owning large-scale service migrations — designing safe cutover strategies, backfills, and rollback plans. Solid grounding in relational/NoSQL data modeling and schema evolution. Experience with caching layers (Redis or similar), CDC/change-data-capture pipelines, and cache invalidation strategies. Comfort with operational ownership: writing alerts, runbooks, and debugging production incidents. Experience with media/video processing pipelines, third-party transcoding vendors, or content-safety systems. The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: CAD 72,056 to CAD 138,940 Capgemini provides compensation range information in accordance with applicable national, state, provincial, and local pay transparency laws. The base compensation range listed for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Capgemini, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. This range may be subject to change as permitted by law. The actual compensation offered to any candidate may fall outside of the posted range and will be determined based on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction. These may include, but are not limited to: Geographic location, Education and qualifications, Certifications and licenses, Relevant experience and skills, Seniority and performance, Market and business consideration, Internal pay equity. It is not typical for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the posted compensation range. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional compensation such as variable incentives, bonuses, or commissions, depending on the position and applicable laws. Capgemini offers a comprehensive, non-negotiable benefits package to all regular, full-time employees. In the U.S. and Canada, available benefits are determined by local policy and eligibility and may include: Paid time off based on employee grade (A-F), defined by policy: Vacation: 12-25 days, depending on grade, Company paid holidays, Personal Days, Sick Leave Medical, dental, and vision coverage (or provincial healthcare coordination in Canada) Retirement savings plans (e.g., 401(k) in the U.S., RRSP in Canada) Life and disability insurance Employee assistance programs Other benefits as provided by local policy and eligibility Important Notice: Compensation (including bonuses, commissions, or other forms of incentive pay) is not considered earned, vested, or payable until it becomes due under the terms of applicable plans or agreements and is subject to Capgemini’s discretion, consistent with applicable laws. The Company reserves the right to amend or withdraw compensation programs at any time, within the limits of applicable legislation. Disclaimers Capgemini is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging inclusion in the workplace. Capgemini also participates in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations (PAIR) program which supports meaningful engagement with Indigenous communities across Canada by promoting fairness, accessibility, inclusion and respect. We value the rich cultural heritage and contributions of Indigenous Peoples and actively work to create a welcoming and respectful environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity/expression, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, genetics, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This is a general description of the Duties, Responsibilities and Qualifications required for this position. Physical, mental, sensory or environmental demands may be referenced in an attempt to communicate the manner in which this position traditionally is performed. Whenever necessary to provide individuals with disabilities an equal employment opportunity, Capgemini will consider reasonable accommodations that might involve varying job requirements and/or changing the way this job is performed, provided that such accommodation does not pose an undue hardship. Capgemini is committed to providing reasonable accommodation during our recruitment process. If you need assistance or accommodation, please reach out to your recruiting contact. Please be aware that Capgemini may capture your image (video or screenshot) during the interview process and that image may be used for verification, including during the hiring and onboarding process. Click the following link for more information on your rights as an Applicant in the United States. http://www.capgemini.com/resources/equal-employment-opportunity-is-the-law Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

review_candidates.title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack java - Junior
review_candidates.description: Descrição da vaga Procuramos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior entusiasmado(a), curioso(a) e com muita sede de aprender para integrar o time responsável pela construção do zero (greenfield) da nossa nova Plataforma de Renda Fixa. No Bullla, o desenvolvimento de software é impulsionado por uma esteira de Inteligência Artificial Generativa (utilizando assistentes como Google Gemini e Anthropic Claude). Você terá a oportunidade de acelerar seu aprendizado e evolução profissional trabalhando lado a lado com Tech Leads e desenvolvedores Sêniores, utilizando IA para construção de código Java, testes e automação de processos desde o primeiro dia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Responsabilidades e atribuições: Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful em Java/Spring Boot e de interfaces modernas de usuário Aprender e aplicar ferramentas de IA (Gemini e Claude) na rotina diária de codificação, para otimizar tempo e qualidade das tarefas Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários) sob orientação de engenheiros sêniores Acompanhar correções de pull requests e aplicar os conceitos de Clean Code e SOLID sugeridos pelo time Documentar fluxos funcionais, rotas de APIs e instruções de ambiente no repositório do projeto Participar ativamente dos rituais ágeis (dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas) Requisitos e qualificações Requisitos e qualificações: Back-end: conhecimento fundamental de Java e familiaridade com o ecossistema Spring (Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, REST APIs) Front-end: conhecimentos básicos/intermediários de desenvolvimento web (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript) e noções de algum framework moderno (React, Angular ou Vue.js) Desenvolvimento assistido por IA: interesse ativo e uso de ferramentas de IA generativa (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) como suporte ao aprendizado e à programação Qualidade e testes: noções básicas de testes de software (testes unitários com JUnit/Mockito, Jest ou similares) e de boas práticas de Clean Code Bancos de dados: conhecimento básico de bancos relacionais (SQL, consultas simples, tabelas e relacionamentos) Controle de versão: familiaridade com Git e fluxos colaborativos (branches, commits, pull requests, GitHub/GitLab) Interesse por mercado financeiro e vontade de aprender sobre produtos e rotinas de Renda Fixa e Crédito (desejável) Transformamos mundos sonhados em trajetórias reais.🧡🚀 Aqui somos #SangueLaranja! Estamos há 17 anos no mercado, lado a lado com nossos clientes, proporcionando experiências transformadoras. Somos um ecossistema de tecnologia e inovação, com expansão global; Além do Brasil estamos presentes na Europa e Reino Unido com escritórios em Portugal, Londres, Dubai e Holanda. 🌎 F de Formação: acreditamos na prática da cultura do compartilhamento, no senso de comunidade, e que o conhecimento tem o poder da transformação! Possuímos iniciativas, e ações sociais, que promovem o desenvolvimento, como a comunidade tech Orange Juice, o Programa de Formação, nossa escola de liderança e diversas parcerias com ONGs e Edtechs. Na FCamara todos são bem-vindos, para nós, Diversidade, Respeito e Ética, são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte do nosso DNA. E aí, está pronto para fazer parte de um time incrível e ser protagonista da própria história?

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer I - 3D Graphics in Maps SDK for JavaScript (m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: Overview Are you passionate about computer graphics topics such as globe rendering, 3D geographic information systems (GIS) or digital twins? In the past few years, Esri has put a large effort into making 3D GIS accessible and powerful for both consumers and experts, across all platforms and devices. We are dedicated to continually pushing the boundaries of 3D GIS on the web, and you can play a key role in our mission. At the Esri R&D Center-Zurich, we lead the development of Esri’s core 3D web technologies: the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript and the 3D Scene Viewer in ArcGIS Online. We are seeking a skilled software engineer on our Experience team with a strong focus on 3D development and user experience. As a JavaScript/TypeScript developer, you can expect to work on designing and building software that is both easy to use and expressive, enabling our users to build stunning 3D interactive maps. Responsibilities Design and implement new software components for the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, spanning a wide range of topics such as web service consumption, data processing and analysis, core rendering functionality and 3D mapping Drive the public API design for new features Apply and promote good software engineering practices such as test automation, modularization, simplification Evolve and maintain our build process, test automation infrastructure, and other custom tooling Requirements Practical experience in software development, in particular computer graphics, image processing, computer vision or related fields 1+ year of experience with JavaScript and TypeScript Background with HTML, CSS, Angular and or React Knowledge of build and package management tools for JavaScript (webpack, vite, etc.) Experience in software design and architecture Excellent creative and critical thinking Ability to work in a fast-paced team environment with frequent releases and tight schedules Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field Recommended Qualifications Background in computer graphics, real-time rendering, WebGL, WebGPU Experience with: Performance testing and optimization of real time 3D applications GitHub actions or other test and CI tools Familiarity with agile software development methods (Scrum, etc.) Master’s degree in computer science or a related field Our Zurich Team Enjoys Free coffee, tea, and soft drinks Fun team activities Competitive salary 40-hour work week Flexible working hours Dynamic, fast-growing international team The Company At Esri, diversity is more than just a word on a map. When employees of different experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and cultures come together, we are more innovative and ultimately a better place to work. We believe in having a diverse workforce that is unified under our mission of creating positive global change. We understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion is not a destination but an ongoing process. We are committed to the continuation of learning, growing, and changing our workplace so every employee can contribute to their life’s best work. Our commitment to these principles extends to the global communities we serve by creating positive change with GIS technology. For more information on Esri’s Racial Equity and Social Justice initiatives, please visit our website here. If you don’t meet all of the preferred qualifications for this position, we encourage you to still apply! Esri is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email askcareers@esri.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this e-mail address. Esri Privacy Esri takes our responsibility to protect your privacy seriously. We are committed to respecting your privacy by providing transparency in how we acquire and use your information, giving you control of your information and preferences, and holding ourselves to the highest national and international standards, including CCPA and GDPR compliance.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - Maritime Software
review_candidates.description: When a ship goes into dry dock, every day at the yard costs money. The superintendent running the project needs every job, quote and change in one place. When an inspector walks the deck far from shore, the app has to work without a signal. We build the software for both, and we are looking for a senior engineer who wants to own a real part of it. About UniSea UniSea is a Norwegian company building an all-in-one software platform for the maritime industry. Our software is used on around 4,000 vessels by shipping companies such as Tidewater, Solstad, Scandlines and BSM Cruise Services. Around 30 developers work from our offices in Skudeneshavn, Bergen and Berlin, and remotely. What you will work on You will join the team behind two of our products: Maindeck : planning and running dry-docking and repair projects, from specifications and tendering with shipyards to yard selection and cost follow-up. Inspections : vessel inspections, with a mobile app that works fully offline and syncs when the vessel is back in coverage. Both products share one Rails web application, and each has its own React Native app for iOS and Android. Your work will include: Taking features from idea to production: clarifying the problem, designing the solution, building, testing, shipping and following up. For the UI, you build on our design system, and we prototype with AI design tools when a feature needs it. Working across backend, web frontend and mobile, wherever the feature needs it. Building AI into the product. We already run our own MCP server and AI-based features, and there is more to do. Improving what already exists: performance, test coverage, code quality and how we work. Reviewing code and sharing what you know with the team. Who we are looking for How you work matters more to us than a perfect match on our stack. You lean in. When you see something that needs doing, you do it or you raise it. You ask the right questions, then drive. When something is unclear, you get the clarification you need early. Then you move the work forward yourself, without anyone having to chase you. You own the outcome. Done means shipped, working and used, not just a closed ticket. You have senior judgement. You know when to keep it simple, when to push back, and how to explain a trade-off. You use AI tools well and understand what they produce. We work with tools like Claude Code every day. We want someone who is comfortable with them, and who understands the code and the choices behind it well enough to see when a tool gets it wrong. You want to learn the domain. No prior knowledge of ships or the maritime industry is needed. You pick up domain knowledge as you go, and you talk to our domain experts when you need to. You communicate clearly in English. Norwegian is not required. Experience that helps (non of it is a must) Several years of building and running production software. Ruby on Rails, ideally with Hotwire, PostgreSQL and background jobs. React Native or Expo with TypeScript, especially offline-first apps and data sync. Automated testing and CI/CD. Building AI features into products. The maritime industry, or another industry where software supports physical operations. Our stack Ruby on Rails 8, Hotwire (Turbo, Stimulus), ViewComponent, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq · Expo, React Native, TypeScript, RSpec, Jest, Maestro · GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes , Claude Code. Every branch goes through automated quality gates for style, security, test coverage and complexity. What we offer Software used on around 4,000 vessels, solving real problems for the people who run them. Competitive salary. An annual company trip somewhere in Europe. Everyone travels together, and you can bring your partner. Social clubs with activities through the year. Help with the work permit and a moving bonus if you relocate to Skudeneshavn (or its proximity). Where you will work We have offices in Skudeneshavn, Bergen and Berlin. Most of the team is in Skudeneshavn. If you live within commuting distance of one of our offices, you will work from that office. If you live elsewhere in Europe, remote work is possible. Working from one of our offices is still a plus. Moving to Norway For the right candidate, we help with relocating to Skudeneshavn, a small coastal town on the island of Karmøy on Norway's west coast. We help you apply for a skilled worker residence permit, which can be a path to permanent residency in Norway. We also offer a moving bonus that covers some of the cost of the move. How to apply Apply through LinkedIn. We review applications as they come in and want someone to start as soon as possible, so apply early. In your application, tell us briefly about a time you took the initiative on something nobody asked you to do: what you noticed, what you did, and what happened.
